item.title: Teen who killed four people in 2024 shooting at Georgia high school is sentenced to life without parole
item.description: The judge’s decision comes nearly two years after the teenager entered Apalachee High School, about 45 miles northeast of Atlanta, with an AR-15 rifle and fatally shot two 14-year-old students and two teachers. Now 16, he pleaded guilty Friday to 55 charges related to the massacre, including multiple counts of felony murder.

item.title: Florida kills former police officer by lethal injection in first of back-to-back executions
